##### Project general facts

Damac Hills – Golf Town is a contemporary low-rise residential community located within DAMAC Hills, overlooking the Trump International Golf Club Dubai. The project is designed around the golf course landscape, offering residents expansive green views and a calm suburban atmosphere. The architecture emphasizes open layouts and generous terraces that maximize natural light and panoramic golf course scenery, creating a residential environment focused on comfort, space, and connection to nature.

The development benefits from full access to the lifestyle amenities and infrastructure of the wider DAMAC Hills community. Residents enjoy proximity to parks, leisure areas, sports facilities, retail outlets, and golf-oriented recreation, all integrated within a master-planned environment. The golf-front positioning creates a resort-like ambiance while still offering convenient connectivity to key areas of Dubai, making the project attractive for both permanent living and investment purposes.

The apartments feature calming contemporary interiors and equipped kitchens designed to provide a comfortable and practical living experience. Residences in Golf Horizon, Golf Panorama, Golf Promenade 1–5, and Golf Vista include equipped kitchens, while homes in Golf Terrace and Golf Veduta are delivered fully furnished with equipped kitchens. The overall interior standard combines modern finishes with functional layouts suited to relaxed golf community living.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
